intro: Ethiopia's distance runners are legends of world athletics.

chapters.title: Running
text: Abebe Bikila won the 1960 Olympic marathon running barefoot in Rome, the first Black African Olympic champion. Haile Gebrselassie, Kenenisa Bekele and Tirunesh Dibaba followed. Tamirat Tola won the marathon in 2024.

chapters.title: Football
text: Ethiopia won the Africa Cup of Nations in 1962.
